selection_reason: Screen one bounded 2008 acquisition/control decision using the complete official CNINFO inventory through the 2008 annual-report cutoff. The screen asks whether pre-outcome records contain a same-entity mechanism from control/action through product, unit-economics and cash observations; it does not select a management winner or read the 2009 result period.

source_research_rationales.selection_reason: Locate the disclosed invitation and pre-action decision context for the Little Swan stake.
Read the official asset-acquisition terms, consideration and stated operating perimeter before using any later performance data.
Confirm whether the control transfer was implemented; this is an action receipt, not an economic result.
Establish the post-transfer 2008 operating and financial state available at cutoff, including any entity-boundary or reporting limitations that would govern a 2009 outcome contract.
